pages.text: In this chapter you will learn how to build a basic axe from ingots.$(br2)Ingredients:$(li)1xMetal Ingot$(li)1xStick$(li)1xPaper$(li)1xBlack Dye

$(bold)1st Step:$()$(br)Go to your blacksmith table, put your ingot inside and set the recipe to the Unfinished Pickaxe Head.$(br)$(bold)2nd Step:$()$(br)Heat the ingot in the forge.$(br)$(bold)3rd Step:$()$(br)Place the ingot in the anvil with the tongs and start hitting it with the hammer until it turns in the selected piece.

$(bold)4th Step:$()$(br)Now take an Iron Stick in your offhand and hammer the piece again until it gets complete (you will listen a sound when completed).$(br)$(bold)5th Step:$()$(br)Once the piece it's cold   combine it with a stick in a crafting grid.
